But the function authenticate_travel expects client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, user_first_name, user_last_name. They also mention "授權類型應設置為 read_write". So we need to call authenticate_travel with those parameters. The user says "我的訪問令牌是 abc123xyz" but that might be the access token? But the function doesn't take access_token. It takes client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, user_first_name, user_last_name. So we ignore the access token. We'll call authenticate_travel with client_id=my_client_id, client_secret=my_client_secret, refresh_token=my_refresh_token, grant_type=read_write, user_first_name=Michael, user_last_name=Thompson.
